1.title: Grade 1: Number Sense, Addition, Subtraction & Foundations
1.subtitle: Counting within 120, fact families, place value tens/ones, 2D shapes, and 'Make a 10' mental math hacks.

2.title: Grade 2: Place Value to 1,000, Regrouping, Arrays & Money
2.subtitle: 3-digit base-ten models, column addition/subtraction regrouping, rectangular arrays, coin currency, and compensation hacks.

3.title: Grade 3: Multiplication, Division, Fractions & Area
3.subtitle: 0-12 Times tables, distributive multiplication decomposition, unit fractions, area (A = lw), perimeter, and 9s finger tricks.

4.title: Grade 4: Multi-Digit Algorithms, Factors, Fraction Operations & Angles
4.subtitle: Multi-digit multiplication area models, long division with remainders, prime/composite, fraction + -, decimals, and divisibility rules.

5.title: Grade 5: Fraction × ÷, Multi-Digit Decimals, Volume & Order of Operations
5.subtitle: Fraction multiplication and division (KCF), decimal arithmetic, coordinate plane, 3D prism volume, GEMDAS, and butterfly method.

6.title: Grade 6: Ratios, Unit Rates, Negative Integers & Pre-Algebra
6.subtitle: Proportions, unit rates, negative integers, absolute value, one-step equations, statistical spread (IQR), and polygon area.

7.title: Grade 7: Signed Integers, Direct Proportions, Percentages & Two-Step Equations
7.subtitle: Signed integer arithmetic, direct variation (y = kx), percent applications, two-step equations/inequalities, and circle geometry.

8.title: Grade 8: Linear Functions (y = mx + b), Exponent Laws & The Pythagorean Theorem
8.subtitle: Slope-intercept form, systems of equations, integer exponent rules, scientific notation, Pythagoras (a² + b² = c²), and 3D curved volumes.

9.title: Grade 9: Polynomial Factoring, Quadratic Theory & Exponential Functions
9.subtitle: Polynomial arithmetic, quadratic ac-factoring, Quadratic Formula & discriminant (Δ), parabola vertex, and exponential growth/decay.

10.title: Grade 10: Deductive Proofs, Trigonometry (SOH-CAH-TOA) & Circles
10.subtitle: Two-column congruence proofs (SSS, SAS, ASA, AAS, HL), right triangle trigonometry, special triangles, circle theorems, and trig hand trick.

11.title: Grade 11: Complex Numbers, Logarithms, Unit Circle & Series
11.subtitle: Complex field (C), synthetic division, logarithm laws & ln, complete Unit Circle, trigonometric identities, and infinite geometric series.

12.title: Grade 12: Limits, Derivatives, Integrals & Advanced Constants
12.subtitle: L'Hôpital's rule, derivative rules (Power, Product, Quotient, Chain), optimization, FTC, U-substitution, tabular integration, and Euler's constants.
